title: Post-Quantum, Byte-Preserving DICOM Exchange with Witness-Backed Provenance Verification
description: Research prototype for byte-preserving DICOM exchange using ML-KEM-768, HKDF-SHA-256, AES-256-GCM, ML-DSA-65, a custom Merkle-style log, signed checkpoints, and witness-quorum checks. This release includes source code, selected regression tests, selected Tamarin models, and sanitized experimental summaries. It is an experimental research artifact, not a clinical or production system. The historical harness hash does not match the currently available source copy; see PROVENANCE.md for the reproducibility caveat. The custom Merkle log is not claimed to be fully RFC 9162 conformant. General signature-based duplicate-witness rejection remains unresolved.
